# Deep Dive: AI Impacts on Markets

Report 111 | Published 2023-05-28 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-5-28/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/111.json)

AI opportunities across software, money and chips.

The strongest call is the multi-year Bitcoin direction and the strongest technology diagnosis is real AI adoption. Adobe illustrates why operating success is distinct from shareholder returns; the TSM/Nvidia relative preference faces adverse three-year evidence. Gold-certificate accounting omits a statutory constraint. Several AI claims are open scenarios or decade-long expectations, not settled wins.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

The adverse scenario is explicitly qualified by bill issuance drawing on RRP. That offset materialized, limiting reserve drainage. No forced early termination of QT followed; this is a conditional risk diagnosis rather than an unconditional market-crash call.

### 111-C04

**Yellen can reprice gold**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | gold-certificate-unilateral-revaluation |
| Source blocks | 19, 25 |
| Thesis family | gold-certificate-unilateral-revaluation |

The accounting manual describes entries after an official-price change, but 31 USC 5117 fixes certificate valuation by statute. It does not give Yellen unilateral authority to replace $42.222 with $2,000. This misses a binding legal prerequisite even though the proposal is labeled unlikely.

**Direction:** Contradicted within the defined test.

**Timing:** No numerical deadline was stated.

**Mechanism:** See rationale; this is not a forecast hit.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [31 USC 5117](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2024-title31/pdf/USCODE-2024-title31-subtitleIV-chap51-subchapII-sec5117.pdf) | US Code | Verified in the audit

Statute caps outstanding gold certificates at $42 and two-ninths per fine troy ounce. Accounting instructions do not independently authorize the Secretary to replace that statutory valuation.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Liquidity:** Funding mix Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Labor leads:** Cycle divergence Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Valuation charts:** Growth versus price Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Separate easier production from who captures profits.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
